Maya (PM): Quick sync — post-launch prioritization needed. Proposing we split the backlog into 3 lanes: P0 (prod crash / data loss), P1 (customer-facing regressions/blockers), P2 (nice-to-have UX/quality). Need gating rules for canary vs full rollout. Thoughts? cc @Jon @Dina
Jon (Eng): +1 to three lanes. Use telemetry triggers: error rate spikes, rising 5xx, and # of unique affected customers. Also suggest a 72h regression window after deploy to auto-escalate.
Dina (SRE): We can automate flags. Example alert query I'll add to infra: `service:inference | errors | where timestamp > deploy_ts` — run nightly and tag new errors with `postlaunch:true`. Recommend tagging enterprise tenants with `customer-lane:enterprise`.
Luis (Support): FYI we have two enterprise tickets (CustA, CustB) about embedding mismatch. Marking them P1. Would like opt-out flag if we need a temporary workaround.
Sam (Design): From UX side — a few follow-on polish items; none are blocking. Can we batch UX polish into a visible milestone unless customers are blocked? Also propose a 5% canary for UX changes.
Maya (PM): Good. Can we capture a quick scoring rubric so triage is consistent? I'll sketch one.
Maya (PM): ```
score = (impact * 5) + (customer_count * 3) - (work_estimate)
impact: 3=prod crash, 2=feature loss/regression, 1=minor
customer_count: 0..3 (0=no customers, 3=multiple enterprise customers)
work_estimate: 0..5 (rough dev effort)
if score > 10 => P0
if 7 <= score <= 10 => P1
if score < 7 => P2
```
Jon (Eng): That looks usable. I'll wire up a GitHub action to compute a preliminary score on issue creation and add a label. Also propose weekly triage (Mon 10am) to review borderline P1/P2.
Dina (SRE): I'll add the alert-to-issue automation and surface latency p50/p95/p99 per model route so we can correlate regressions quickly.
Luis (Support): I'll prepare a customer-facing SLA/status email template for enterprise customers when we trigger P1 escalations.
Sam (Design): I'll collect UX polish candidates and mark which are safe to batch vs those that should be hotfixed.
deploy-bot: New deployment recorded: deploy_id=2212345600 -> stage=canary percent=5 timestamp=2212345680
Maya (PM): Decisions: adopt scoring rubric; owners: P0=Jon (Eng), P1=Luis (Support), P2=Sam (Design). Action items: Jon create kanban + GH action, Dina add alert automation, Luis draft SLA email, Sam gather UX list. Reconvene Mon 10am for first triage. :thumbsup:
Jon (Eng): I'll create the `postlaunch-triage` kanban column and the GH workflow today.
Dina (SRE): Done — alert rule and webhook stub added, will run nightly.
Luis (Support): Draft ready, will share in #product by EOD for review.
Sam (Design): I'll upload the UX list to the triage board and flag any high-visibility items.
Maya (PM): Thanks — owners, please update the kanban cards with ETA and the initial score before Monday. We'll lock the P0 response SLA in the runbook.
Jon (Eng): Sounds good.
Luis (Support): :thumbsup:
Dina (SRE): :eyes:
Maya (PM): Closing thread — meeting invite sent for Mon 10am. If anything urgent pops up before then, ping #product and tag owners.
